accounts.name: owner
docs: later close. Only its key is used, as a PDA seed and as the position owner.

accounts.name: treasury_ata
docs: The pinned destination. Not caller-chosen: rotating it is an admin act with its own event.

accounts.name: source
docs: Any token account of the right mint that the treasury authority controls.

accounts.name: destination
docs: The vault (for a principal return) or the coupon pool (for funding), checked per handler.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin funds the accounts and holds the admin authority afterwards. It must be the
program's upgrade authority: the singleton config would otherwise belong to whoever
landed `initialize` first in the window between deployment and the ceremony. On mainnet
the upgrade authority is the Squads multisig, which signs through its vault.

accounts.name: treasury_ata
docs: The draw destination: a token account of the right mint owned by the treasury authority,
so a draw can only ever land with the party that signs draws. The admin rotates it later
under the same rule.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Anyone. The keeper in practice; the curator or a bystander can crank their own row.

accounts.name: owner_ata
docs: The owner's own token account for the mint; the payout goes nowhere else.

accounts.name: treasury_ata
docs: Must be owned by the treasury authority being set and must not be one of the vault's own
accounts, so principal can never be drawn into the coupon pool or back into the vault.

accounts.name: treasury_ata
docs: The pinned destination, as for draws.

accounts.name: treasury_ata
docs: The pinned destination, as for draws.

types.name: Config
docs: Vault configuration and running totals. One per program deployment.

fields.name: emergency_authority
docs: A hot key with one-way powers only: it may pause or halt, never clear either flag.

fields.name: vault_ata
docs: Principal, a program-owned token account at seeds ["vault"].

fields.name: coupon_ata
docs: Coupon pool, a program-owned token account at seeds ["coupon"].

fields.name: treasury_ata
docs: Destination of treasury draws; a Forest Road token account, rotated by the admin only.

fields.name: coupon_owed_total
docs: Sum of every position's accrued but unpaid whole coupon units.

types.name: Position
docs: One curator's subscription. Non-transferable by construction: there is no instruction that
changes `owner`, and no token represents it.

fields.name: agreement_hash
docs: Hash of the executed agreement, set when the wallet is allowlisted.

fields.name: lock_seconds
docs: Terms snapshotted when a zero-principal position receives new principal.

fields.name: principal
docs: Live principal in USDC base units.

fields.name: drawn
docs: Principal from this position currently deployed to the treasury.

fields.name: coupon_payable
docs: Portion of `coupon_owed` earned through a completed month and payable now.

fields.name: payout_halted
docs: Set by the allowlist authority on a screening hit: the crank refuses this position while
accrual continues and the amount stays owed. Withdrawals are not affected by this flag;
whether they should be is counsel's question (spec section 3.4).

types.name: RateEpoch
docs: One rate epoch: `bps` applies from `start_ts` until the next epoch's start.

constants.name: ACCOUNT_VERSION
docs: Account layout understood by this program. Reserved bytes let later versions add fields
without forcing every curator to exit into a replacement program first.

constants.name: DAY_COUNT_ACTUAL_360
docs: Day-count code for Actual/360, the only convention this version implements.

constants.name: MAX_RATE_BPS
docs: Rates are basis points on Actual/360; 100% is the ceiling, not a target.

constants.name: MIN_TERM_SECONDS
docs: Terms bounds: one day to two years, for both the lock and the notice.
